text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
And now, let's welcome to the stage!
Our very own "Chiyaji-san," Kitasan Black-san!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, thank you so much for putting together
such a wonderful debut party for me today!

text_block_list.name: Cheering Squad Man A
text_block_list.text:
What are you saying? Don't be a stranger!
Throwing a party or two is nothing if it's for you, Chiyaji!

text_block_list.name: Cheering Squad Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! Do you have any idea how long we, the
'Chiyaji-san Fan Club,' have been waiting to see you in that racing outfit?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Aha, even Trainer-san too!
Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to everyone who supports me,
I was able to get such a wonderful racing outfit!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
When I was thinking up the design,
everyone gave me so much advice, didn't they!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Take this Seigaiha wave pattern, for example—

text_block_list.name: Cheering Squad Man B
text_block_list.text: I was the one who recommended it! 'Cause I want Chiyaji-san to stay healthy and keep running for a lo~ng time to come!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I want to keep running full of energy forever, too!
And as for the plum and cherry blossom patterns—

text_block_list.name: Cheering Squad Woman B
text_block_list.text:
"You endure and endure, and after all that effort, things will bloom.
I sure hope Kita-chan's efforts will blossom too!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Please watch over me as I bloom in full glory!
I'll believe in myself and in all of you, and keep devoting myself to training!

text_block_list.name: Cheering Squad Man A
text_block_list.text:
"And on top of that,
the most important thing of all is the shape of the outfit!"

text_block_list.name: Cheering Squad Man A
text_block_list.text:
"Well obviously, festivals are what Uncle Chiyo's all about!
Nothin' beats making it look like a happi coat!"

text_block_list.name: Cheering Squad Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Darn right I am! I've been carrying portable shrines
since I was knee-high to a grasshopper, no objections here!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me! On my pride as a festival girl, I'll get this race super hyped up!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I was so genuinely happy that everyone
gave me such enthusiastic advice on the design!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Yay! *Clap clap clap*!)
choice_data_list: You gave form to everyone's wishes!
You really gave form to everyone's wishes!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: That's right! I want to carry the feelings of everyone who supports me on my back!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wishing for health, wishing for hard work to bear fruit...
Everyone's feelings of faith in me
are what give me strength—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to carry all those feelings
and run as hard as I can in these racing colors!
choice_data_list: Does the color of the decorative cord in the back have a meaning too?
Let's make that wish come true together!
Let's make that wish come true together!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to carry all those feelings
and run as hard as I can in these racing colors!
choice_data_list: Does the color of the decorative cord in the back have a meaning too?
Let's make that wish come true together!
Let's make that wish come true together!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's... hehe.
Actually, I picked out the color of the cord myself!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Red and white are auspicious, right?!
Just looking at them cheers you right up.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I get so much energy from everyone's cheering, so I wanted to give that energy right back!

text_block_list.name: Cheering Squad Man A
text_block_list.text:
Don't talk nonsense! We're always
gaining courage from your running and singing, Chiyaji-san!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! In that case, I gotta work e~ven harder
and show what I've got on the big stage!

text_block_list.name: Cheering Squad Woman A
text_block_list.text: Sing for me first, in hopes that that "someday" will come!

text_block_list.name: Cheering Squad Woman B
text_block_list.text:
Now that's what I'm talking about... Let's hear
one of Kita-chan's legendary, soul-stirring vocal runs!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, no problem at all!
Don't stop at one, ask for two or even three!

text_block_list.name: Cheering Squad Man B
text_block_list.text: Woo-hoo, we've been waiting for you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The crowd cheered enthusiastically for the passionate performance. It was a day that truly showed how much the locals cared.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
I look forward to working with you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: As long as I'm with you, Trainer, I'm sure we can run in a way that gives everyone dreams to believe in!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ngh! Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Cheering Squad Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Nice, aren't you quite the dependable,
fine Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Cheering Squad Man B
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's give three cheers in honor of
Trainer and Chiyaji-san!

text_block_list.name: Cheering Squad Members
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, hooray!
Trainer, hip hip hooray!"

text_block_list.name: Cheering Squad Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Oh jeez, who's the one
going around shouting "Heave-ho!"?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, sounds great!
Trainer, heave-hoooo!!

text_block_list.name: Cheering Squad Members
text_block_list.text: Chiyaji-san, heave-hooo!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black carried all the hopes of her hometown on her shoulders.
Seeing how deeply she was loved was a humbling experience that made me brace myself.
